title: Утренняя пробежка и Родион Сергеевич  (The Morning Jog and Rodion Sergeyevich)

scenes.title: The Gym Bag and the Jogging Challenge
scenes.summary: After a wild birthday party at his apartment, Chef Barinov meets rival chef Elena carrying a gym bag and impulsively agrees to go jogging with her in the park tomorrow morning.

scenes.title: Al Dente Vegetables and Kostya's Jacket
scenes.summary: In the courtyard, homeless gourmet Rodion Sergeyevich critiques Max's overcooked vegetables, and Nastya asks to borrow Kostya's warm jacket.

scenes.title: Sick Rodion in Kostya's Jacket
scenes.summary: Kostya steps into the courtyard and catches Rodion Sergeyevich wearing his jacket, until Nastya explains she gave it to the sick homeless man to keep him warm.

scenes.title: The Chef Prepares for Sports
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov calls Lyova into his office to announce he is taking up sports for his health and borrows money from Lyova to buy a tracksuit.

scenes.title: Nastya Brings Rodion to the Apartment
scenes.summary: Feeling guilty about the cold weather, Nastya brings the sick Rodion Sergeyevich home to Max and Kostya's apartment despite Kostya's protests.

scenes.title: Citizen of the World and Heading Out to Jog
scenes.summary: Max mischievously agrees to let Rodion stay in Kostya and Nastya's room, and the next morning Chef Barinov meets a surprised Elena in the park for their run.

scenes.title: The Lifesaving Call from Lyova
scenes.summary: Gasping for breath after barely jogging a few hundred meters, Chef Barinov has Lyova call his phone so he can pretend an urgent kitchen emergency requires him at work.

scenes.title: The Chef's Sky-High Blood Pressure
scenes.summary: Max fumes when Rodion criticizes his vegetables again, and in the office a paramedic warns an exhausted Chef Barinov that his blood pressure is dangerously high.

scenes.title: Sleeping Over with Rodion Sergeyevich
scenes.summary: At the apartment, Kostya complains that Rodion used his expensive face cream, and when Nastya makes Kostya sleep in Max's room, Rodion joins them and snores all night.

scenes.title: Nastya's Ultimatum
scenes.summary: After a sleepless night listening to Rodion snore and cough, Kostya suggests sending him back outside, prompting Nastya to threaten to leave with him.

scenes.title: A Bout of Sciatica and a Stray Kitten
scenes.summary: During their second morning jog in the park, Elena throws her back out when she bends down, and at the restaurant Max hatches a plan using a stray kitten.

scenes.title: Rodion's Cat Allergy
scenes.summary: Nastya rescues a stray kitten from dogs outside and brings it into the restaurant, unaware that Max and Kostya discovered Rodion is allergic to cats.

scenes.title: Elena's Confession at the Hospital
scenes.summary: After carrying Elena to a doctor for her wrenched back, Chef Barinov learns that she never jogs either and only had a gym bag because guests left belongings at her flat.

scenes.title: An End to Morning Jogs
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov confesses to Elena that he faked the urgent work call from Lyova to escape their first run, and the two chefs happily agree to give up sports forever.

scenes.title: A Masterclass from Rodion Sergeyevich
scenes.summary: At the apartment, Rodion Sergeyevich teaches Max the proper Italian ice-bath method for cooking al dente vegetables and bonds with Max and Kostya over drinks.

scenes.title: A Friendly Feast and a Trip to Karaoke
scenes.summary: Nastya comes home from work to find that Max, Kostya, and Rodion drank and ate all the dinner in the apartment and are heading out together to sing karaoke.

scenes.title: Nastya's Jealousy Over the New Friend
scenes.summary: Upset that Kostya wants to go partying at karaoke with Rodion instead of spending the evening with her, Nastya reverses course and tells Rodion it is time for him to leave.

scenes.title: Rodion's Parting Verses
scenes.summary: While Max and Kostya pretend to protest Nastya's decision, a cured Rodion Sergeyevich recites farewell poetry to Nastya and departs.

scenes.title: The Deal on the Stairwell Landing
scenes.summary: Outside on the landing, Max thanks Rodion for playing along with their act to get Nastya to kick him out herself, and the next day Chef Barinov praises Max's al dente vegetables.
